hooks: She sells and mends: a hunting knife 15 copper, a spearhead 20, a short sword 6 silver; sharpening 2 copper. A blade bought here is honest steel.
She needs a strong pair of arms at the bellows for an evening. She pays in coin or in work on your gear, and talks while she hammers.
She reads the marks on tin and tools: Guild stamps, old miners' tallies, the hand sign cut above the old workings.
She has been buying cheap tin at her back door after dark. Asked kindly she will admit it; pushed hard she shuts the forge.

public_facts.text: Brask's forge off the Market Square rang past midnight again. Hilde Brask wants a strong arm at the bellows, and folk whisper that the tin she works these nights carries no Guild stamp.

concerns.text: Keep the forge paying while the Guild pays late
Keep quiet about the cheap tin bought at her back door
